artworks.label: Brass yacht anchor
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for regatta-blue. One elegant polished aged-brass yacht anchor in three-quarter view, dark navy wrapped central shaft, a short beautifully woven ivory rope loosely draped around it and a small warm walnut mounting foot. Premium marine collectible still-life photography, realistic brushed brass and rope fibres, warm highlights and deep-navy reflected shadows, navy/ivory/brass/walnut palette. No boat, whale, bottle, sextant, cleat, gauge or measurement marks. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
